evidence: Inspected the current PA-10 A page and its assigned draft item bodies. The local dg-enhancement fixes cohomological grading and a degree-one differential, uses right dg modules, and states the derived mapping-space/Ext convention. This is an interface inspection of draft suppliers; it does not claim batch acceptance.

Inspected the actual supplier Definition. It gives a cohomological DGA with degree +1 square-zero differential, associative unital multiplication, central base-ring action, and signed Leibniz rule d(ab)=d(a)b+(-1)^|a|a d(b). The local enhancement uses those conventions for each endomorphism complex. Supplier is draft; inspection is not acceptance.

Inspected the actual supplier Definition. Its right dg module has degree-zero action and satisfies d(ma)=d(m)a+(-1)^|m|m d(a); left and right conventions are kept separate. The local enhancement declares right dg functors and does not identify left and right modules. Supplier is draft; inspection is not acceptance.

Inspected the current PA-19 A page and the actual bodies of all four declared Hall suppliers. The category is small finitary abelian, the untwisted product counts a subobject isomorphic to the second input with quotient the first, the product is finite, and it is associative with unit. This exact supplier order makes the heart map an anti-homomorphism. These are draft bodies, not accepted results.

Inspected the actual supplier Definition. Its hypotheses are a small abelian category with finite Hom and finite Yoneda Ext^1 sets for each pair; it does not assume a field-linear structure. The heart theorem states finitarity separately and works over the finite-field dg enhancement. Supplier is draft; inspection is not acceptance.

Inspected the actual supplier Definition and full convention paragraph: [M]*[N] counts short exact sequences 0→N→L→M→0, equivalently subobjects N with quotient M. Therefore Toën's source-as-subobject/cofiber-as-quotient multiplication corresponds to the opposite ordinary Hall algebra. Supplier is draft; inspection is not acceptance.

Inspected the actual supplier Statement and complete Proof. Its finite-support argument uses the finite Hom set to bound candidate middle objects and finite endpoint-fixed Yoneda Ext^1 to bound extensions. The heart theorem separately invokes the supplier only after checking the chosen heart is finitary. Supplier is draft; inspection is not acceptance.
